biography.plain_text: Nicholas A. Mastroianni II is an American developer and investment executive. long_biography.plain_text:
A multigenerational construction business gave Mastroianni an early platform in property. By 1992, he was directing the family's expansion into hospitality and industrial work. Moving to South Florida, he created a development company whose signature Jupiter waterfront scheme combined shops, restaurants, residences and a hotel.

His next step was financing. A regional-centre business formed with Nicholas III in 2010 channelled foreign investors' money into American developments, including major New York projects. That shift made fundraising, contracts and project selection central to his role. Later, father and sons organised their interests under a new family umbrella. Its operations also cover private equity, entertainment, technology and agriculture.
